alo-toronto.quote: Reservations for Alo's Dining Room, Parlour Room, and Private Dining Room are released on the first Tuesday of each month at 10 AM. 72 hours notice to cancel or reschedule a dining room, kitchen counter or parlour room reservation without penalty.
